abilities.name: Guardian's Answer
abilities.description: Once per round, when an allied Tamer or Digimon within 5 spaces of your partner Digimon is hit by an attack, you may spend 2 Hope to have your partner Digimon use a Free Action to hit back with a Basic Attack against whoever just attacked them.

abilities.name: Full Answer
abilities.description: When your partner Digimon retaliates with Guardian's Answer, they may use their signature move or any move from their move pool instead of their Basic Attack.

abilities.name: All In
abilities.description: When your partner Digimon retaliates with Guardian's Answer, you may spend Hope to boost that attack's hit roll. Every 1 Hope spent grants +2 to the hit roll, up to a maximum of 5 Hope spent for +10.

abilities.name: Back in It
abilities.description: Once per encounter, when an allied Tamer or Digimon has been removed from the encounter, whether they dropped to 0 HP or chose to submit, you may spend your Basic Action to make a Recovery check. That ally immediately returns to the fight with HP equal to the result of your check.

abilities.name: Never Stops
abilities.description: Guardian's Answer no longer costs a Free Action, and it's no longer limited to once per round. Your partner Digimon can retaliate every single time an ally within range is hit, as many times as it happens.

abilities.name: Share the Load
abilities.description: As a Free Action, you may decrease up to 3 of your own Crest Stats by 1 each. For every stat you decrease this way, choose one allied Tamer and increase that same Crest Stat by 1 for them. These changes last until you undo them. As a Free Action at any time, you may undo Share the Load entirely, immediately restoring your own Crest Stats and removing the bonus from every ally who received one.
